## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the

Tuya fan was the only Tuya platform that wasn't refactored in November.
This PR makes a start for that.

Still no entity descriptions, but at least it now tries to resolve which data points to use (and uses more). Additionally, added the `fskg` Fan wall switch, as I used that as one of the test devices.

Replace and closes #64668

issue_context.title: Lost light entities for my light/fan combo tuya switches
issue_context.body:
### The problem

These switches were partially supported in the previous v2 tuya integration and were scheduled to be fully supported in the next milestone release.  When I migrated from the v2 tuya integration to this new official one after the v2 was deprecated, the integration worked the same for these switches, namely:

Fan:  can toggle in lovelace and automations, saves state, but does not support fan speed
Light:  cannot toggle in lovelace, can toggle in automation, does not save state correctly, and does not support brightness

After installing 11.0, and resolving the login API bug, all my light entities are unavailable.  No change in Fan functionality.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

21.11.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

21.10.7

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Tuya

> I have the same issue here.

@uliaraujo Please don't use "I have the same issue" comments, those are not helpful. Instead, just add a 👍  to the issue description. Thanks 👍

> > previous v2 tuya integration
> 
> That is a custom integration and not related to the Home Assistant Core integration.

Hi, to clarify, I had switched over to the core integration and had light entities for my fan/dimmer switches in versions up to 10.7 but lost them upon update to 11.0 (and now 11.1).  Understood that further improvements to the integration may come from Tuya and HA but wanted to call out that I did lose functionality between 10.7 Tuya core integration and 11.0-1 Tuya core integration.

Thanks!
FWIW, I followed some instructions on installing the LocalTuya integration and, for me, it seems to be working well and supports all of my devices (after some configuration trial-and-error).
